appearances.title: Antigravity migrates a 174k-line Fortran model to safe Rust in 59 minutes
appearances.summary: Using Gemini 4 Argon, Google Antigravity migrated the 174,774-line FVCOM Fortran ocean model into memory-safe Rust in 59 minutes, matched the original numerical output across 100 seeds, found six legacy bugs, and ran 1.88x faster while using about half the memory. The workflow is released as an open-source /migrate-to-rust skill.
